historical_papers.rawText:
BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: IMSC   SEMESTER: IV
BRANCH: FOOD TECHNOLOGY  SESSION : SP/2019

SUBJECT: IMF4003 PRINCIPLES OF FOOD PROCESSING & PRESERVATION

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) How conservation of mass and conservation of energy is related to process operation? [2]
 (b) How do you remove or restrict the growth of microorganisms in any food product? [3]

Q2 (a) What is water activity?  [2]
 (b) Correlate  between  water  activity  and  moisture  content.  How  it  is  related  to  food
preservation?
[3]



Q3 (a) Mention role of bound water for the structural stability of food materials. [2]
 (b) What is permeability? How permeability of packaging material gives consistent effect
on food product quality?
[3]

Q4 (a) What is TDT curve? [2]
 (b) What is monolayer moisture content? How it is related to BET equation? [3]

Q5 (a) How reduction of temperature acts as preservation method? [2]
 (b) How sorption isotherm behavior is evaluated for a particular product?   [3]



Q6 (a) What is D value? [2]
 (b) How  D value  of  food  constituent  and  D  value  of  microbes  play  critical  role  during
sterilization process?
[3]
